conviction_note: The one line that has historically moved this name is gross margin, and the component cost that management named as the margin risk on 8 June has roughly doubled in price since they set guidance; partially offset by a flagship/ASP mix that lands in Q3, so I take a modest net negative rather than anything near the 16% median reaction.

findings.finding: Zepp set its H2 2026 margin expectations on 8 June 2026 with CFO Leon Deng naming memory as the specific gross-margin risk ("we expect higher memory costs to create near-term pressure on gross margins, driven by the industry-wide transition from DDR4 to DDR5 and high-bandwidth memory") and naming ASP increases plus a possible tariff refund as the offsets; since that date the consumer DRAM squeeze has escalated sharply — TrendForce on 22 June 2026 said consumer DRAM shortages had cascaded all the way down to DDR2 (contract prices +35-40% QoQ in 3Q26) and that OEMs/ODMs were substituting DDR4 designs with DDR3 and DDR3 with DDR2 to hold system cost. Zepp's gross margin had already fallen from a company-record 40.4% in Q4 2025 to 37.7% in Q1 2026, so the 1 September margin print and the H2 margin commentary are being made into a materially worse cost environment than the one management described in June.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody has a model to update. Nasdaq carries no EPS estimate and an n/a estimate count for ZEPP, the option chain is unusable (ATM bid-ask 109% of mid, 764 contracts total open interest, so there is no skew to read), and the stock is UP 12.98% over 20 sessions on ~38-41k shares a day. If a component-cost squeeze on a 37%-gross-margin hardware microcap were priced, you would see a pre-print drift lower, at least one preview note cutting a margin assumption, and puts bid; there is no coverage at all and no negative drift.
findings.independence: Zepp's own transcript establishes the exposure (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/06/10/zepp-health-zepp-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/, 2026-06-10) and Tom's Hardware independently reports DRAM and NAND prices still climbing through Q3 2026 with consumers hitting an affordability limit (https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/ram/memory-price-surge-begins-to-cool-as-consumers-hit-affordability-limit-ai-demand-still-keeps-dram-and-nand-prices-climbing-through-q3-2026). TrendForce 2026-07-09 puts conventional DRAM contract prices +13-18% QoQ in 3Q26 (https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260709-13140.html).

findings.finding: The Balance 3 / Balance Ultra family, announced 2 June 2026 and presented as 'launched' in the Q1 release six days later, did not actually go on sale until the turn of June and July 2026 (Balance Ultra and Balance 3 Stainless Steel at the turn of the month, Balance 3 Titanium 'a few weeks later'). So the quarter being reported on 1 September carries essentially none of the new flagship line, while Q3 is the first quarter to carry both $599.99 SKUs (Balance Ultra and Cheetah 2 Ultra) — against a backdrop where portfolio ASPs rose more than 20% YoY in Q1 2026 and all seven 2026 launches were holding at MSRP with no discounting.
findings.why_not_priced: This is product-press granularity that exists nowhere in a financial document: the Q1 press release and the wire copy say the products were launched, not that they shipped after quarter end. With zero sell-side coverage there is no one to phase the revenue, so the same fact cuts two ways nobody has separated — Q2 headline revenue skewed toward the low end of the $63-68m guide, Q3 guidance skewed above the hard $75.8m comp. If this were priced you would see a published Q2/Q3 revenue split for ZEPP somewhere; there is not even a consensus EPS number.
findings.independence: Prices and premium positioning corroborated separately by T3's launch write-up (https://www.t3.com/active/fitness-trackers/amazfit-balance-3-balance-ultra-launch-0626) and the ASP/no-discounting point by the5krunner's separate pricing piece of 2026-06-09 (https://the5krunner.com/2026/06/09/amazfit-price-rises-2026/). Overlaps with finding 1 only insofar as ASP increases are management's named memory-cost offset.

findings.finding: Zepp quietly exited Oura's ITC Section 337 case: Oura and Zepp jointly asked the ITC to terminate Zepp from Investigation No. 337-TA-1468 on 9 July 2026 and the administrative law judge granted it on 10 July 2026, removing the risk of a US limited exclusion order against the Amazfit Helio Ring ahead of the Helio Ring 2 and Helio Strap 2 launches confirmed for H2 2026. Terms were not disclosed, so a settlement or royalty charge could surface in the Q3 numbers rather than Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: The termination happened on an ITC docket in July and was reported only on 21 August by a gadget blog. Zepp filed no 6-K about it (EDGAR shows no 6-K at all between 2026-06-09 and 2026-08-31) and no wire picked it up. If it were priced there would have been a company release, a 6-K, or a dated move in the tape; the 20-day tape shows drift with no single-day news gap.
findings.independence: Oura's own ITC action announcement establishes the case and the exclusion-order stakes (https://ouraring.com/blog/itc-action-patent-infringement/). Independent of findings 1, 2, 4 and 5.

findings.finding: The share repurchase authorisation that management still describes as active is effectively dormant: Zepp had used US$16.0m of the US$20m program as of 30 June 2025 and only US$17.0m as of 31 March 2026 — about US$1m of buying across nine months during which the ADS fell roughly 90% — leaving US$3m of capacity on a program that expires in November 2026. Shares outstanding are down only 1.66% year over year (14.66m ADS, market cap ~US$72m) against US$103.2m of cash at 31 March 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Getting to it requires stitching a number said once on a call ($17m of $20m) to a number in a press release nine months earlier ($16.0m as of 30 June 2025) for a company with no analyst following. Management framed it positively ('an effective use of capital'), so the holder's takeaway is 'the company is buying its stock' when the pace says otherwise. It also removes the only tidy explanation for the +12.98% 20-day run-up on ~40k shares a day: there is no corporate bid under this print. If the market had done this arithmetic the run-up would need a different, visible cause, and there is no 6-K or release in the window to supply one.
findings.independence: The 30 June 2025 figure comes from a different document, the Q2 2025 results release (https://www.zepp.com/press-release/zepp-health-corporation-reports-second-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results). Share count corroborated at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/zepp/statistics/.

findings.finding: Point72 Asset Management, Point72 Capital Advisors and Steven A. Cohen filed Amendment No. 2 to their Schedule 13G on 14 August 2026 reporting 0.00 shares and 0% of ZEPP as of 30 June 2026 — a full exit. The remaining 13G-scale holder disclosed in the same August window is Morgan Stanley / Morgan Stanley Capital Services at 8.8% with shared voting and dispositive power, i.e. a dealer/swap position rather than a fundamental one.
findings.why_not_priced: Schedule 13G/A go-to-zero filings on a US$72m ADR are read by nobody; five 13G/As were filed on this name between 6 and 14 August 2026 and none generated a headline. It matters only because it says who is not there to absorb a print with a 5-of-7 down history: the institutional holders left from the 2025 squeeze have gone and what remains at scale is a swap book. If this were priced the 13G/A dates would show up as volume in the tape; 20-day average volume is ~38-41k shares.
findings.independence: Morgan Stanley's 8.8% position is a separate filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1720446/000089542126000253/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml, 2026-08-13). Independent of findings 1-4.

searched_and_found_nothing: Third-party Q2 2026 smartwatch shipment data: neither Counterpoint's Global Smartwatch Tracker nor IDC's Worldwide Wearable Device Tracker has published a Q2 2026 release yet (latest available is Q1 2026, +4% YoY smartwatches / 145.7m wearables), so there is no independent unit read on Zepp's June quarter before the print
Any 6-K, F-3, ATM, convertible or capital-raise filing since the 9 June 2026 results 6-K — EDGAR shows nothing but Schedule 13G/As and two Form 4s between 2026-06-09 and 2026-08-31

Insider signal: the only Form 4s (2026-06-29/30) are CFO Deng Cheng's routine RSU vest and sell-to-cover (22,875 ADS vested, 9,836 sold at $4.61 wavg), no discretionary open-market activity by any insider
A short squeeze setup: short interest is 379,663 shares, 5.91% of shares outstanding, down from 469,053 the prior month — 10 days to cover is high but 5.9% is not a squeeze

Customer-complaint waves: r/amazfit and the Zepp app issue trail in 2026 shows only ordinary firmware bugs (Exertion score, BioCharge on Active 2 / Bip 6, DST-related HR and weather), no recall, no systemic quality event

Amazon best-seller-rank or review-velocity history for the T-Rex / Balance / Active lines across the Q2 window — no citable historical rank series I could reach, and Prime Day 2026 discounting (15-42% on older SKUs) is not distinguishable from a normal promo cadence

Layoffs / restructuring / WARN notices or a visible hiring-page change at Zepp Health — nothing found either way, so no independent check on management's promised opex step-down from $37.1m to '$30 million a quarter or even lower'
Any residual Xiaomi-ecosystem disclosure: Xiaomi is not mentioned anywhere in the Q1 2026 call, so the sweep's lead there is dead
Nasdaq/NYSE listing-compliance correspondence: the ADS trades near $5 on NYSE, so the 91.8% drawdown carries no minimum-price issue
baseline_tension: The baseline offers no priced direction at all — no usable chain, no skew, no consensus — so the only thing to beat is the 16% median reaction and the +12.98% 20-day run-up, and my main finding cuts against that run-up: the cost input management flagged as the margin risk got dramatically worse after guidance was set, in a name where the two most recent prints fell 22% and 29% on margin and guidance, while the offsetting flagship/ASP mix lands in Q3 rather than in the quarter being reported.
